body:
# Hoppin's Backrooms Resource Pack

Hoppin's Backrooms Resource Pack retextures select vanilla Minecraft blocks to recreate the iconic look of the Backrooms. Custom textures for Froglights, Yellow Wool, Yellow Carpet, Bamboo blocks, and Iron Trapdoors provide everything needed to build authentic liminal spaces using familiar vanilla blocks.

Whether you're creating Backrooms maps, horror experiences, roleplay servers, or atmospheric builds, this pack helps bring the endless yellow hallways to life without requiring mods.

## Features

* Custom Backrooms-themed textures
* Retextured Froglights with ceiling light designs on all sides
* Modified Yellow Wool and Yellow Carpet
* Custom Bamboo block textures
* Retextured Iron Trapdoors for light grates and vents
* Vanilla-friendly and easy to use

Perfect for Backrooms, liminal space, and horror-themed builds.
